## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds or changes one Topping only.
- [ ] I read and can explain the complete submitted source.
- [ ] Source is readable, unminified, and contains no remote code or dependencies.
- [ ] Match patterns use exact hosts and the narrowest working paths.
- [ ] Catalog metadata, semantic version, scopes, and SHA-256 match source.
- [ ] No analytics, tracking, advertising, credential access, or data exfiltration exists.
- [ ] Storage and network behavior is fully disclosed above.
- [ ] Keyboard use, readability, and existing page accessibility remain intact.
- [ ] I have the right to publish this code under its declared SPDX license.
